recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中數個圓形、胞質幾乎透明無色、內含小空泡且細胞核被推到邊緣的大細胞，大小遠超周圍造血細胞，是骨髓脂肪細胞（adipocytes）。
features: Large round cells, several times the diameter of surrounding hematopoietic cells
Abundant clear to very pale lavender cytoplasm filled with lipid (appearing empty or finely vacuolated)
Single small, oval, eccentric nucleus compressed to the periphery
Adipocytes embedded within a cellular particle of small dark hematopoietic cells
Background of thick smear areas with cracked, grey-staining proteinaceous/lipid material
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear (May-Grünwald-Giemsa) shows a cellular particle containing several large round adipocytes with abundant clear, lipid-filled cytoplasm and small, eccentric, compressed nuclei. The surrounding cells are small hematopoietic cells, which cannot be characterized in detail at this magnification. No crystals, organisms, or foamy histiocytic cytoplasm are seen in the fat cells. Findings are consistent with normal marrow adipocytes.

ddx.vs: Foamy macrophages have bubbly, finely vacuolated grey-blue cytoplasm with a central or bean-shaped nucleus rather than a single large clear lipid droplet with a flattened peripheral nucleus.
Gaucher cells have fibrillary 'wrinkled tissue paper' blue-grey cytoplasm, not clear empty cytoplasm.
Gelatinous transformation shows small atrophic fat cells in pink-purple amorphous extracellular material with hypocellular marrow, rather than normal-sized adipocytes within cellular particles.
